timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I lost my patience and I feel bad about it.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep replaying what I said.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am afraid I hurt someone I love.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I am judging myself harshly right now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body still feels tense from the moment.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I wish I had responded differently.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like a bad person for snapping.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel ashamed.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This guilt is sitting heavily on me.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can be honest about what happened without spiraling.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: One moment does not undo how much I love them.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I was overwhelmed, not cruel.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can separate the moment from who I am.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can release some of this tension.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can repair this without punishing myself first.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am allowed to be imperfect and still be a good person.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can meet myself with the same patience I want to give them.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let this guilt soften.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am capable of repairing this with care.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can learn from this moment without living in it.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to respond better next time.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can see myself clearly, not just this one moment.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel calm again.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can apologize and mean it.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: My love for them is bigger than this mistake.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I am someone who tries, even when I fall short.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to reconnect.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
